BiblicalUsage: Gabriel is the angel who explains Daniel's visions. A man's voice between the banks of Ulai calls in Daniel 8:16, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision, and in Daniel 9:21 the man Gabriel, whom Daniel had seen in the vision at the beginning, touches him about the time of the evening oblation. He is the messenger who makes the mysteries plain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God sends His messengers to make hard things clear. Daniel could not understand the vision alone, so Gabriel was sent, and I hold that God still gives understanding to those who ask Him for it.
